ns2:course.label: Chinese Thght Confucius to Mao
ns2:course.description: Examination of China's principal philosophical, religious, and political schools of thought - such as Confucianism, Taoism, Zen Buddhism, and Maoism - as ways of understanding one of the world's major civilizations; the period of the classical philosophers, the glory years of empire, and the troubled era of Western contact receive approximately equal attention. Same as HIST 222 and RLST 224.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Hist&Philosoph Perspect, and Non-Western Cultures course.
